adjudication: This additive scope identifies English Sandaconda082/163 with the black GameStop stamp and one Cosmos Holo finish. Unstamped Battle Styles Holo/Reverse/Cosmos and EB Games stamps are different identities. Generic provider Holofoil is not an additional physical finish.
